patch_description: Rather than repeatedly descending from a few repaired samples, this approach maintains a small, diverse set of networks and runs annealed walks from them. LP detail identifies bottleneck links, which are preferentially included in degree-preserving exchanges; occasional three-link rotations add a different neighborhood. The free surrogate energy ranks proposals before LP evaluation, while temperature-based acceptance lets walks cross local barriers. Cached and duplicate networks are skipped so the LP budget is spent on new topologies.
